_source: AI-researched NEW DISTRICT candidates for Manchester and Cheshire, awaiting human review — never auto-promoted into docs/data/districts.json. Populated by the same daily scheduled research agent as venue-suggestions.json (2026-08, at explicit user request). Expected to be rare: the research brief (.claude/agents/curia-research-daily.md) treats district suggestions as an occasional finding (a genuinely distinct, not-yet-covered high-end area within Manchester or Cheshire), not a daily quota — most days should add zero entries here. Each entry mirrors docs/data/districts.json's own raw shape (name/metro/lat/lon/base/kind/accentColor/editorialDescription) so an approved entry can be copied straight in, plus review-only fields (suggestedDate, status, researchNotes) stripped before promotion. `metro` must be 'manchester' or 'cheshire' only — never 'los-angeles' or a new metro (out of scope, per the user's explicit 'shouldn't go beyond cheshire and manchester just yet').
_reviewWorkflow: Same as venue-suggestions.json: status starts 'pending', a human reviewer flips it to 'approved' (then copies fields into districts.json) or 'rejected' (kept here with researchNotes so it isn't re-suggested).
